Yes, you'd likely pay for shipping. Your items total $85, and the $10 code brings it to $75. Free Standard shipping applies to orders of $75+ after discounts and before tax, so $75 exactly qualifies, and Standard would be free.

So with that code, Standard shipping is free. Express would still cost $14.95 (never free), and it isn't available in Zone 3. If the plant is XL (usually over 4 ft), a $20 handling fee applies on top.

Sorry, my opening line was wrong: you would not pay for Standard shipping on this order.
